<!-- Pull requests require a maintainer-approved tracking issue. -->

## Decision record

Primary issue: #

- [ ] The issue has `decision:approved`.
- [ ] A maintainer confirmed this implementation and reviewer.
- [ ] This PR stays within approved scope.

## Human summary

Explain what changed, why it is necessary, and why this is the smallest
complete change.

## Tests and evidence

List exact commands, platforms, scenarios, and results.

## Compatibility, security, and rights

Describe migration, rollback, public contracts, trust boundaries,
dependencies, provenance, and third-party material. Use `N/A` with a reason.

## Risk

- [ ] `risk:normal`
- [ ] `risk:critical`

## AI assistance

Select exactly one:

- [ ] No material AI assistance
- [ ] Material AI assistance used

If used, identify the tool category, affected files/tasks, manual review,
independent verification, external data sent, and residual uncertainty.

## Final review

- [ ] I reviewed and understand every changed line.
- [ ] I did not weaken valid tests.
- [ ] Every commit includes my human DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I will follow this work through review or explicitly release it.
